toolRequests.arguments: {"command":"git add -- formats/css/vite.config.ts .changeset/fix-css-export-builds.md && git commit formats/css/vite.config.ts .changeset/fix-css-export-builds.md -m \"fix(css): emit all exported stylesheets\"","explanation":"Stage and commit only the CSS export repair and its changeset, leaving concurrent user files untouched.","goal":"Commit CSS export fix","mode":"sync"}
